source_term: absolutely continuous, truly continuous, and singular functionals
target_term: fungsional kontinu mutlak, kontinu sejati, dan singular
source_text:
\leader{232A}{Absolutely continuous functionals} Let $(X,\Sigma,\mu)$ be
a measure space and $\nu:\Sigma\to\Bbb R$ a finitely additive
functional.
target_text:
\leader{232A}{Fungsional kontinu mutlak} Misalkan $(X,\Sigma,\mu)$ suatu
ruang ukur dan $\nu:\Sigma\to\Bbb R$ suatu fungsional aditif hingga.
